title: Connect QA concepts to their disclosure moments
text: The public verification home already introduces methods, plans, activity, the verdict-producing case run and the first-work registered command binding. Keep those existing first-use instructions current. JOURNEYS owns deeper worked examples that connect method/case/plan/requirement, item-versus-run subjects, targets, machines and review at the actual disclosure moment. Individual lessons retain research questions and pending exact recipe proof; they do not prove live adoption or waive current-work requirements.
